title: Resume stalled rollouts: protected pair starts, open track crawls again
notes: The protected pair is the most schedule-critical gap: both sat at zero per cent rollout with nothing started, yet they are the flags to be archived live on stage. Their chain is rollout, seven days targeting-stable, code removal, drain, seven days silence, thirty days age — roughly twenty days minimum. Starting today clears 5 October with margin rather than by luck.

Only flags whose consumers are actually deployed after s020 are targeted here. Targeting a flag with no caller advances the schedule without buying evidence, which is the mistake made with demo-tax-calculation-v2 and deliberately not repeated.
demo-checkout-address-validation is left alone: its consumers demo-shipping and demo-checkout are still not deployed under the four-evaluator cap.
The open-track flags resume their slow crawl so something is still visibly mid-crossover on demo day rather than everything having finished.
